title_en: JANUS E03 — SCOBY-derived bacterial cellulose as a distinct scaffold candidate in axolotl-inspired human skin regeneration modeling
title_ru: JANUS E03 — бактериальная целлюлоза SCOBY как возможный биоматериал для моделирования заживления человеческой кожи

provenance.source: User instruction in 2026-11-09 JANUS regeneration discussion: do not forget kombucha SCOBY and bacterial cellulose.
provenance.historical_lineage: Additive follow-up to E01/E02; previous raw synthetic outcomes are unchanged.
integrations_proposed_only: JANUS Meta Registry append-only experiment tracking

scientific_boundaries.axolotl_biology: Limb regeneration depends on coordinated cell populations, nerves, immune signaling, extracellular matrix, positional identity and cellular growth control.
scientific_boundaries.axolotl_dECM: Axolotl decellularized extracellular matrix retains proteins and bioactive tissue signals; it is not equivalent to cellulose from a fermented kombucha pellicle.
scientific_boundaries.scoby_raw: Raw SCOBY pellicle is an unstandardized microbial fermentation product, not a sterile medical dressing.
scientific_boundaries.kombucha_purified_cellulose: Purified kombucha bacterial cellulose is a cellulose-rich hydrated nanofibrillar structural material; potential scaffold properties do not imply induction of limb or finger regeneration.
scientific_boundaries.medical_restriction: No unverified material should be placed on open human wounds and no human treatment recommendation follows from these models.
scientific_boundaries.translational_endpoint: Begin with material properties and human skin wound-healing endpoints; full fingertip and limb regrowth remain separate unsupported claims.

literature.title: Kombucha Bacterial Cellulose Obtained from Tea Fermentation for Biomedical Applications
literature.claim_ceiling: Review of potential wound dressings, tissue-engineering scaffolds and biocompatibility challenges. Not proof that homemade SCOBY regenerates tissue.

literature.title: Kombucha-Derived Bacterial Cellulose for Active and Biodegradable Food Packaging
literature.claim_ceiling: Differentiates raw pellicle, fermented tea and purified KBC; provides physical material constraints but packaging is not clinical effectiveness.

literature.title: Axolotl-derived decellularized skin ECM as a pro-regenerative scaffold for attenuating fibrotic wound healing
literature.claim_ceiling: Reported better dermal repair in murine preclinical model; axolotl ECM is not kombucha cellulose.

literature.title: Bacterial cellulose-chitosan-silver nanocomposite from coffee kombucha: A biofabricated matrix for in vitro wound healing
literature.claim_ceiling: In vitro assay on chemically modified kombucha-derived composite; not efficacy of untreated SCOBY or human fingertip regeneration.

model_revision_plan.goal: Replace uncalibrated E01/E02 tissue-regrowth proxies with material-specific parameterization from published measurements and held-out biological response data.

components.name: Purified KBC physical scaffold
parameters: hydrated Young modulus or effective stiffness
components.units: source-specific measured units required; do not fabricate

components.name: Cell and matrix interface
components.units: only if measured in a study of comparable material and context

components.name: SkinGPT observation bridge
components.units: engineering telemetry; not proof of skin regeneration

components.name: Axolotl-inspired biological dynamics
components.units: separate from KBC physical parameters, validated only by comparable data

comparator_conditions: standardized purified bacterial cellulose (single-strain or published commercial benchmark)
published clinical-grade reference wound dressing, if appropriate data exist
axolotl dECM only as separately labeled literature reference—not a like-for-like cellulose control
primary_endpoints: out-of-sample agreement with measured hydration/stiffness and skin-repair time series
uncertainty and missingness by parameter and material origin
sensitivity to structural equations and tissue context
scar-related endpoints if externally measured, never extrapolate to finger regrowth
strict_rules: Keep raw SCOBY excluded from therapeutic testing and clinical-use proposals.
Do not input invented measurements into parameter-fitting datasets.
Do not infer in vivo outcomes from cell scratch assay without an explicit limitation.
Freeze held-out split and metric definitions before fitting.
Keep synthetic ablations separate from empirically measured experiments.
Do not equate material changes with neuroregeneration, complete organ repair, or memory transfer.
Record negative results and safety-gate failures append-only.
model_revision_plan.start_gate: Locate source-level quantitative data for purified KBC and appropriate controls; establish comparable endpoints before new numerical claims.

next_actions: Review 2025–2026 open publications for measured stiffness, swelling, porosity, cytotoxicity and epithelial readouts in purified KBC.
Create source-linked dataset with values, units, model-system labels, sample sizes, uncertainty and provenance.
Implement E03 calibrated mechanical/transport submodel, not speculative human-regrowth estimate.
Evaluate on separate published datasets and compare baseline dressing/material models.
Only then assess whether a joint ECM+KBC system is a justified distinct hypothesis.
additional_notes: This research record incorporates the user's SCOBY/biocellulose constraint into the next JANUS regeneration milestone. It documents a plan only; there are no E03 synthetic or wet-lab results.
